shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright monolith/stela
elaborately costumed anthropomorphic figure occupying the main field
large headdress or elaborate cranial ornament at the top
circular disc/medallion motif on the chest or torso region
vertical composition with figure filling the shaft
justification: Both surfaces show a single frontal, elaborately adorned anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief filling a tall vertical shaft, with an ornate headdress at top and a prominent circular disc/medallion at the chest, plus curling scroll ornaments — a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest difference in depicted content is that B's figure is a fully articulated standing personage with visible arms, legs, held implements and dense glyph-like signs and a secondary head, while A is a massive head-and-torso form whose lower body is undifferentiated and which lacks any comparable sign panels or limbs.
